data.narrative:
Gecko Robotics is a Series D robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $125M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of nine private peers and one public comparable, all operating in the same sector and stage band. Key private comparables include Exotec ($2.0B Series D), Hadrian ($1.6B Series D), and Divergent ($2.3B Series E), alongside earlier-stage peers Agile Robots and Nimble Robotics (both $1.0B Series C).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $125M total raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.5x step-up multiplier typical for Series D advancement, implies $188M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $2.3B. The peer-based method reflects valuations of robotics companies at equivalent maturity.

The triangulated analysis across both methods supports a range of $159M to $1.8B, with a median of $894M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty regarding Gecko's relative market position, revenue traction, and unit economics versus the peer set. Stage-progression suggests a more conservative floor, while peer multiples indicate significantly higher valuation potential if Gecko has achieved comparable momentum to Series D robotics peers. Resolution of this range depends on visibility into current revenue run-rate and customer concentration.
